items.description: Food establishments operating in St. Clair County must obtain the applicable Michigan food service license and comply with county health-department inspection and permit requirements.

feeDetail.note: Temporary food service fees range from $35 to $159 depending on risk, nonprofit status, and filing timing; fixed-operation fees vary by license type.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Obtain and renew a St. Joseph County food service license
items.authority: St. Joseph County Health Department / Michigan local health department
items.description: Food service establishments operating in St. Joseph County must obtain the applicable local food service license and comply with Michigan inspection and renewal requirements.

feeDetail.note: Food service fees are set by the local health department; Michigan distinguishes local food service licenses from MDARD food establishment licenses.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Sanilac County food service license
items.description: Food service establishments operating in Sanilac County must obtain the applicable Michigan food service license through the local health department and comply with state food-law requirements.

feeDetail.note: Fees are determined by the local health department and operation type.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Obtain and renew the applicable food establishment license
items.description: Food establishments operating in this jurisdiction must obtain the applicable state or local food license before operating and renew it as required.

feeDetail.note: Food service fees are set by the local health department; Michigan distinguishes local food service licenses from MDARD food establishment licenses.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Shiawassee County food service license
items.description: Food service establishments operating in Shiawassee County must obtain the applicable Michigan food service license and complete plan review for new or remodeled facilities.

feeDetail.note: The 2026 county schedule lists food establishment license fees by class, including $155 for STFU licenses and $932 for Class IV establishments, plus applicable state fees.

penalty.note: Annual licensing applications incur a late fee after April 30; the schedule also doubles fees when construction begins before plan approval.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Tuscola County food service license
items.description: Food service establishments operating in Tuscola County must obtain the applicable Michigan food service license before operating and comply with county inspection requirements.

feeDetail.note: Published county fees are $476 fixed new license, $412 fixed renewal, $242 mobile, $68 temporary, and $111 special transitory, plus state fees.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Van Buren County food service license
items.authority: Van Buren / Cass District Health Department
items.description: Restaurants, mobile food units, and special transitory food units operating in Van Buren County must obtain the applicable Michigan food service license before operating.

feeDetail.note: Van Buren / Cass District Health Department fees vary by fixed, mobile, special transitory, or temporary food license type.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: Obtain a Washtenaw County food service license
items.description: The Washtenaw County Environmental Health Division licenses and inspects food service establishments; use the county permit process and current fee schedule before operating.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.

items.title: File the Wayne County convention facility development tax return
items.description: Hotels and motels with more than 80 rooms in Wayne County outside Detroit must file the monthly state convention facility development tax return; Detroit has separate rates and the current official instructions control.

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register; the tax is the amount the return reports.

penalty.note: The state page this entry cites gives no penalty amount.
